description: Scan generated text for verbatim reappearance of the original values held in a protected session (tolerant of spacing, dashes and case for identifier-like values) and re-tokenise anything found. Returns which token categories leaked — never the raw values — plus the sanitised text and a general self-check. Scope is verbatim reappearance only: paraphrases and inferred identities are not detected.
name: check_output
title: Check output for leaked identifiers
